factoidalLean.glueAdaptation: Browser-only URL/runtime adaptation; no change to Lean Wasm bytes.

implementation.cryptoPrimitive: WebCrypto SHA-384 + Ed25519, matching danja/jigdaw Signature.js normative implementation
implementation.onlineKeyResolution: Optional; fetched verification method is parsed by Lean Factoidal and must agree with inline sec:publicKeyMultibase.

boundary.statement: This interop verifies Danny's profile/bundle signing semantics. It does not make an identity/trust decision from a valid unknown key, and it does not claim that jigdaw-eddsa-2026 itself signs Diddums' JIGP proof-audio certificate.
boundary.future: A JigDAW-compatible signed profile can bind a Diddums proof-audio WAV as a resource by integrity digest, or a separate audio-attestation profile can be specified without pretending it is already normative in danja/jigdaw.
